svg.aria-label: Levels of prevention pyramid for NCD
svg.text: Q5 · Levels of Prevention of NCD 🛡

g.text: Prevents the emergence of risk factors themselves — before they appear / become endemic.
Directed mainly at children 🧒 — e.g. prevent smoking, high-fat diet, sedentary life, stress early in life.
Population strategy: diet change (↓fat, ↑complex CHO), no alcohol, no smoking, BP control, activity, weight control.
High-risk strategy: serum cholesterol estimation → specific advice (treat HTN, stop smoking).
C) Secondary Prevention 🟡 — early detection & treatment
Screening & health examination techniques · improved diagnostic methods · treatment.
Slogan: catch it early, treat it fast. 🩺
Disability limitation + rehabilitation of the disabled.

svg.text: 1 Screening · 2 Better diagnosis · 3 Treatment & rehab · 4 Control air/water/food pollution · 5 Reduce accidents
6 Influence behaviour/lifestyle (education) · 7 Upgrade institutional care · 8 Comprehensive care incl. PHC · 9 Integrated NCD programme
🎯 Primordial = prevent risk-factor emergence · Primary = prevent onset · Secondary = early detection · Tertiary = rehab & disability limitation
